title: LCTFound: a lung CT vision foundation model facilitating disease diagnosis and medical imaging
core_idea: Develop a large-scale vision foundation model (LCTFound) for lung CT that uses diffusion-based pretraining and joint encoding of imaging plus clinical information, trained on a curated multi-center dataset (lungCT-28M) to support a unified set of CT imaging tasks (enhancement, virtual CTA, sparse-view reconstruction, segmentation, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment response prediction, and 3D surgical navigation).
tldr: Introduce LCTFound, a diffusion-pretrained, multi-task lung CT foundation model trained on a large curated dataset and combining imaging with clinical metadata to enable a unified set of clinical and imaging CT tasks.
